 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board, I recused myself on May 14, 2025 from a discussion or decision regarding a matter before me in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interest of my former subordinate, Kiel Samotej.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board, I recused myself on April 17, 2025 from a discussion or decision regarding a matter before me in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interest of my former colleague Henry Bolwerk. 
 In the exercise of my official function as Member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board, I recused myself on September 21, 2023 from discussions surrounding an application for assessment submitted to the Veterans Review and Appeal Board in order to avoid an opportunity to improperly further the private interests of a former subordinate.
 In the exercise of my official duties on May 9, 2023, I recused myself from all discussions and decisions relating to a hearing of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board in order to avoid any opportunity to further the private interest of an individual I supervised in an employment context between 2008 and 2010.
